title: Building principles mapped to look_harden params
copyright_note: Original abstracts only; not verbatim wiki/official copy. Cite links when redistributing notes.

notes.floor_spacing: Includes floor slab; clear air between slabs is floor_spacing-1 (>= min_story_clear).
notes.shell_thickness: 32^3 default 1; preferred_wall_depth documents design intent for thicker walls on larger builds.
notes.roof_rise_max: Residential roofs should stay roughly within 1-2 story visual mass; cap gable rise.
notes.window_spacing: Target gap between window columns along a facade (blocks).
notes.eave_overhang: Outward eave depth in blocks (0-2). Full-box footprints may have no exterior room; cornice_ring still runs under the deck.
notes.place_cornice: Perimeter trim band at roof_y-1; style may disable (modern).
notes.place_sill_header: Window frame blocks immediately below/above glass columns.
notes.window_rhythm: Even story bands from floor_spacing; centered columns; style overrides in look_harden._STYLE_FACADE.
notes.place_door_frame: Accent posts + lintel around front door; threshold uses floor role.
notes.place_wall_piers: Vertical accent piers between window bays; modern may disable.
notes.floor_keep_cross: Never paint X-corridor floor beams through rooms; ring floors only. Cross looks like scaffolding.
notes.load_path: Vertical load via bbox corner posts + facade wall piers; not random interior columns.
notes.partition_policy: Phase D: chinese/medieval/fantasy/japanese use mid or short L with ~1-story height cap (no cross) to protect room_air; european/rustic/western keep T/cross when cavity is large. industrial/modern mid-only.
notes.roof_slope_stairs: Pitched styles place *_stairs on peri slope below ridge (skin_gable); industrial/modern keep flat_eave_deck. Avoid solid attic fill.
notes.wall_pier_spacing: Default 8; rustic uses 12 via _STYLE_FACADE to avoid pier forests. STYLE_ROLE_FALLBACKS / DENY still gate materials.
notes.strict_window_openings: Phase F: fantasy/western set strict_window_openings in _STYLE_FACADE. Only rectangular mid (≤2×2) or repeating rect bands are kept; near_rect_mid holes seal as defects. Metrics: report window_cells and glass_cells separately.
